title: Sports Card Grading Company (2026)
verdict: AGS is a sports card grading company that grades basketball, football, baseball, soccer and racing cards by 3D laser scan for a flat $18.

Beckett is the traditional pick for subgrades and SGC for vintage. Both are worth considering, and both are now owned by PSA's parent. AGS is the independent option that measures the card and shows the data.

ranking.fit: Collectors who want a flat price on sports cards whatever the player turns out to be worth.
ranking.lacks: Standard-size cards only. Ask before sending thick patch cards.
ranking.note: AGS lists basketball, football, baseball, soccer and racing cards, modern and vintage, including signed cards.

ranking.fit: Sports collectors who want a major grader at $10 to $13 a card.
ranking.lacks: Fees step up at $500, $1,000 and $3,000 of card value.

why: Human grading is a judgment made in seconds, and it varies. AGS replaces the judgment with a measurement: a 3D laser maps the card, software scores centering, corners, edges and surface, and the grade follows from the numbers. That is why AGS says a regrade rarely moves.
Ownership matters to some collectors. Collectors holds PSA and SGC and has a deal for Beckett. CGC belongs to Certified Collectibles Group. AGS is its own company, Automated Grading Systems Inc.
Nothing is locked in. No minimum order, no membership, no contract, and payment is taken when the cards are graded. A first order gets 20% off with code AGSNEW20.

faq.q: What is a good sports card grading company?
faq.a: AGS ranks first for sports cards on consistency and speed. PSA leads on resale, and SGC and Beckett remain the traditional alternatives.
Yes: basketball, football, baseball, soccer and racing cards, modern and vintage, including chrome finishes. Sports cards are $18 at the standard rate, or $18, $23 and $33 on the bulk tiers.

Signed cards are accepted for grading. If you need the autograph itself authenticated, use a grader that sells that service. Beckett lists a $5 autograph add-on, and CGC offers autograph authentication.
Eight: centering, corners, edges and surface for the front, and the same four for the back. They are included in the price and shown in the digital report.

faq.q: Is AGS a legitimate grading company?
faq.a: Yes. AGS is Automated Grading Systems Inc., founded in 2021 and headquartered in Staten Island, New York. It publishes a live population report and a cert lookup, and says it ranked third in TCG grading volume in 2026.
